root_cause: After the external Netlify to Supabase Edge heartbeat proved live and migration 20261007083900 retired the legacy pg_cron owner, powerhouse_commercial_regression_gate_v1 still counted only pg_cron as scheduler authority. The Edge runner then saw a PARTIAL/non-VERIFIED receipt and intentionally threw, rolling back the transaction and leaving no durable heartbeat event.
prevention: The authenticated Edge runner sets a transaction-local external scheduler authority marker. The regression gate counts legacy pg_cron plus the external marker and requires exactly one authority. Manual/direct SQL calls have no marker and remain fail closed; overlapping legacy and external owners count as two and remain unhealthy.
